name: hold-notice
title: Preservation instruction draft
for_each: select id,code from holds order by code

sections.title: Hold scope
sections.note: DRAFT for counsel review. Not sent. This document does not freeze or release data.

sections.title: Custodians and evidence
sections.sql: select c.name,c.email,a.notice_on,a.notice_ref,a.acknowledged_on,a.acknowledgement_ref from assignments a join custodians c on c.id=a.custodian_id where a.hold_id=$1 order by c.name

sections.title: Other unreleased holds for these people
sections.note: Never remove source-system preservation without checking all overlapping obligations.
sections.sql: select distinct c.name,h.code as other_hold from assignments a join custodians c on c.id=a.custodian_id join assignments a2 on a2.custodian_id=c.id join holds h on h.id=a2.hold_id where a.hold_id=$1 and h.id<>$1 and h.status<>'released' order by c.name,h.code
